title: Align stage writer-presence refusal with carried-check interference semantics
outcome: Determine whether a stage authority observation should refuse mere co-presence of another writable session when the carried recorder has recorded no interfering action, and either use the existing carried-fence semantics at stage boundaries or explicitly document the stricter contract. Preserve refusal for actual overlapping writes and unresolved Claude work.
acceptance: Align stage writer-presence refusal with carried-check interference semantics is done
